articles.title: Ripple CEO Blames Democratic Politics for CLARITY Act Failure, Promises Post-Mortem
articles.description: Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse blamed the Democratic politics for the CLARITY Act cloture vote failure and promised a post-mortem.

articles.title: Poor sleep in one partner can affect both partners' diets, new study finds
articles.description: Poor sleep is known to lead to poor diet quality. But as a new Concordia-led study of cohabiting couples shows, poor sleep can affect not only an individual's food choices but also their partner's choices. Because couples who sleep together often eat together, one partner's unhealthy food choices can have a ripple effect on the other's eating habits, the researchers say.

articles.title: AI could disrupt traditional entertainment studio model as production costs fall
articles.description: Artificial intelligence is revolutionising the landscape of entertainment production, offering creators remarkable cost savings. Smaller production companies can now bring projects to life while maintaining their intellectual property rights. With generative AI at the forefront, content creation in areas like audio and microdramas is already gaining momentum. This shift is predicted to ripple across film and high-quality scripted series, leading to significant growth in innovation and content output.

articles.title: Ripple Brings XRP Branding To Louisville Basketball In New Multi-Year Deal
articles.description: Ripple has signed a multi-year partnership with Louisville Athletics that will place the XRP logo across Denny Crum Court, expand arena and media branding, and fund education programs for student-athletes.

articles.title: Ripple CEO Says Crypto Will Win With or Without Clarity Act
articles.description: Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse says crypto will ultimately prevail regardless of the Clarity Act’s fate, arguing that superior technology tends to win even as the landmark bill faces mounting pressure in the Senate.

articles.title: Ripple Backs Stablecoin Startup as Part of $10 Million Funding Round
articles.description: Ripple has doubled down on the stablecoin payments sector by backing a $10 million funding extension for Velocity.

articles.title: Ripple Scores New Sports Deal As XRP Logo Heads To Louisville Basketball
articles.description: Ripple partners with Louisville Basketball, bringing XRP branding to every home game while expanding its presence across college sports.

articles.title: Velocity raises $48M Series A with Visa, Circle and ripple
articles.description: Velocity raised its Series A to $48M with a $10M extension backed by Visa Ventures, Circle Ventures, Ripple, Haun and other investors.

articles.title: AI companies buoyed the U.S. economy. What happens if they slow down?
articles.description: Technology stocks wilted Monday as investors focused on the ripple effects of any new AI controls.

articles.title: Visa, Circle, Ripple back $200M Velocity to link stablecoins with payment networks
articles.description: The investment brings Velocity's Series A round to $48 million and values the London-based payments infrastructure firm at $200 million, CEO Eric Queathem said.
